objects.name: Analytic 2176
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies network device configuration changes (network address translation rules, static routes, access control list modifications) combined with NetFlow path deviations for Industrial Control System (ICS) device traffic and Transport Layer Security (TLS) certificate issuer anomalies in Operational Technology (OT) management traffic. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the asset's documented role does not permit the connection and the destination/proxy/service is outside the approved communications profile, with process/service identity used as corroboration where available. Suppress approved vendor support, update repositories, remote operations, failover paths, and documented temporary connectivity.
